The design brief / Self-initiated study

The brief.

A service-design booklet explaining discovery, planning, pilot implementation and structured handover.

The challenge

A service process can be difficult to understand when discovery, planning, implementation and handover are compressed together.

Design direction.

Present each stage as a distinct step in a consistent booklet structure.
